2658void PrintVOP3A(const FInstVOP3A& Inst)
2659{
2660 const uint32_t VOP1Offset = 0x180;
2661 const uint32_t VOP2Offset = 0x100;
2662
2663 if (Inst.OP >= VOP1Offset && (Inst.OP - VOP1Offset) <= 104 /* v_swapref_b32 */)
2664 {
2665 // VOP1 encoded as VOP3A
2666 EVOP1Ops Op = (EVOP1Ops)(Inst.OP - VOP1Offset);
2667 UE_LOGF(LogTemp, Warning, "%s", ToString(Op));
2668 }
2669 else if (Inst.OP >= VOP2Offset && (Inst.OP - VOP2Offset) <= 60 /* v_pk_fmac_f16 */)
2670 {
2671 // VOP2 encoded as VOP3A
2672 EVOP2Ops Op = (EVOP2Ops)(Inst.OP - VOP2Offset);
2673 UE_LOGF(LogTemp, Warning, "%s", ToString(Op));
2674 }
2675 else if (Inst.OP <= 255 /* v_cmpx_tru_f16 */)
2676 {
2677 // VOPC encoded as VOP3A
2678 EVOPCOps Op = (EVOPCOps)Inst.OP;
2679 UE_LOGF(LogTemp, Warning, "%s", ToString(Op));
2680 }
2681 else
2682 {
2683 EVOP3ABOps Op = (EVOP3ABOps)Inst.OP;
2684 UE_LOGF(LogTemp, Warning, "%s", ToString(Op));
2685 }
2686}
